map.根据年龄、遗尿频率及伴随症状，区分原发/继发性遗尿并给出治疗建议: By age, enuresis frequency and associated symptoms, distinguish primary/secondary enuresis and give treatment advice
map.提示：遗尿症定义为≥5岁儿童夜间不自主排尿，≥2次/周持续≥3个月，无神经系统/: Note: enuresis is defined as involuntary night urine in a ≥5-year-old, ≥2 times/week for ≥3 months, with no neurologic/urologic organic lesion. Primary (NE): never dry ≥6 months (80%); secondary: relapsed after ≥6 months dry (often psychosocial stress/illness). Monosymptomatic (night only) vs non-monosymptomatic (with daytime symptoms). First-line: desmopressin (DDAVP) and enuresis alarm. Constipation can worsen enuresis. This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.7 岁、≥2 次/周→符合遗尿诊断；原发(自幼)单症状性，自发缓解约 90%。: At 7 years, ≥2 times/week -> meets enuresis diagnosis; primary (since infancy) monosymptomatic, spontaneous remission ~90%.
map.已戒后又发+日间症状→继发性，查 UTI/便秘/糖尿等原发病。: Relapsed after being dry + daytime symptoms -> secondary; check UTI/constipation/diabetes etc.
map.几岁诊断？: At what age is it diagnosed?
map.≥5 岁、每周≥2 次方可诊断遗尿，此前多为发育未成熟。: Only ≥5 years and ≥2 times/week can be diagnosed; before that it is mostly immaturity.
map.基础为遗尿闹钟+限晚水，药物(去氨加压素)备用，伴日间症状需综合治疗。: Basics: enuresis alarm + limit evening fluids; medication (desmopressin) as backup; daytime symptoms need combined therapy.
map.关于「遗尿(夜间)与年龄评估器」: About the Enuresis (Nighttime) and Age Assessor
map.儿童遗尿(夜间)与年龄评估器，区分原发性/继发性遗尿，评估夜尿次数及行为/药物治: The pediatric enuresis (nighttime) and age assessor distinguishes primary/secondary enuresis and evaluates night-wetting frequency and behavioral/pharmacologic treatment indications. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
